opening.argument: The video presents a conventional promotional giveaway: the speaker offers viewers a choice between an Ulta or Sephora gift card and sets the value at $75. Entry requires being subscribed and leaving a comment, while the accompanying Q&A and planned winner announcement describe ordinary audience engagement rather than payment, investment, credential submission, or another transaction. The title marks the giveaway as closed, whereas the spoken material describes a contest running for about a month, creating a discrepancy about timing. That inconsistency does not by itself establish a deceptive mechanism or demonstrate any loss, so the material supports a routine rewards promotion.
